title: Excellent practice
content: Reception staff are friendly and helpful. I’ve always managed to get an appointment for my children when they are ill. The doctors really listen and have always provided excellent care for myself and my family. I can’t rate this practice highly enough, thank you all.
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
